slides.title: Overnight in Ethiopia: life in Adigrat after drone strikes
From the Eritrean border
slides.body: Adigrat, where burnt-out trucks remain in the city centre after drone strikes by federal forces on Eritrean troops, AFP reported.

slides.title: Schools closed, shelves thin
slides.body: Schools have been shut for several days. Shops are open, but many are low on supplies, residents said.

slides.title: Insecurity and hunger
slides.body: Residents reported robberies and stabbings after policing broke down, and one said people face severe hunger.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Let aid reach Tigray.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
